ad.title: Instagram Expert
ad.summary: Most social media jobs mean scheduling posts in a queue. This one means running an operation. As our Instagram Expert you own every account we run: you hire and lead the team that posts daily, you control the content schedule, you keep every account healthy and growing, and you answer for the numbers. We built the machine. It needs an owner.

paragraphs: You take command of Halevora's entire Instagram operation. A trained posting team already executes daily cycles across our accounts, documented procedures cover every step, and a content pipeline feeds it all. Your job is to run it: set the standards, enforce the process, catch problems before they cost us an account, and grow the team as we scale.

This is a leadership role with operational depth. One day you are interviewing a new team member, the next you are digging into why one account lost reach. You report to the founder, work European core hours, and get real authority over how the operation runs.

idealCandidate: You have run Instagram accounts at scale, not just your own profile.
You can read an account's health from its reach, and you act before a warning becomes a restriction.
You have hired, trained, or managed people and held them to a standard.
You treat posting schedules as commitments, not suggestions.
You spot when two accounts start looking alike and fix it the same day.
You would rather enforce a boring process than improvise a clever shortcut.
You stay calm when an account gets flagged and follow the playbook instead of panicking.

requirements.title: Instagram at scale
requirements.tagline: The algorithm is not a mystery to you.
requirements.body: You know what grows an account and what quietly kills one: posting cadence, engagement patterns, content variety, reach signals. You have managed multiple accounts at once and kept them all alive and moving up.

requirements.title: Team leadership
requirements.tagline: You build the team and run the game.
requirements.body: You have recruited, onboarded, and managed people before. You give direct feedback, catch sloppy work early, and make people better at their jobs. Your team knows exactly what good looks like because you defined it.

requirements.title: Operational discipline
requirements.body: You run on checklists, procedures, and daily cycles. When a step gets skipped, you notice. When a process wastes time, you rebuild it. You document what you learn so the operation gets stronger every week.

requirements.title: Remote discipline
requirements.body: You have a quiet workspace, a fast and stable connection, and the self-management to lead a distributed team without supervision. Remote leadership is how you do your best work, not a fallback.

whatYoullDo: Lead the daily social sync at 10:00 CET: review account health, clear blockers, and lock the day's posting priorities.
Hire, train, and manage the posting team, and hold every member to the documented standard.
Own the posting and engagement cycles across all accounts: schedules, content distribution, and quality control.
Monitor account health daily, catch flags and reach drops early, and run the recovery playbook when something breaks.
Report growth numbers weekly to the founder and keep improving the procedures the whole operation runs on.
shouldntApply: You want a job that ends when the clock says so. This team runs on an all-in mentality.
You are looking for part-time hours or a side project. We hire full-time only.
You take direct feedback personally. We correct fast and expect you to do the same.
You have only ever posted for yourself. This role manages an operation, not a profile.

pages.title: Instagram Expert Application
pages.description: Complete every required field. We review the quality and accuracy of your answers before inviting anyone to interview.

fields.label: Level of English
fields.help: Select the option that accurately describes your level of English. Be sincere, as we will double-check this during the interview.

fields.label: Country
fields.help: Choose from the list so your application is recorded consistently.

fields.label: WhatsApp Number
fields.help: If you do not have one, please create one. Include your country code.

fields.label: Instagram handle
fields.help: Optional, but it helps us see your work.

fields.label: Where did you hear about us?
60-second voice note
fields.help: Record a 60-second voice note about yourself, right here. Share your previous work and personal experience, and tell us why we should hire you. You can listen back and re-record as many times as you like before you continue.

pages.title: Tell us about the accounts you have run.
pages.description: How many Instagram accounts have you managed at once, for whom, and what were the results? Use numbers: follower growth, reach, posting volume. Accounts you ran for a brand or client count double.

pages.title: Have you managed people before?
pages.description: Tell us about the team you hired, trained, or ran: how many people, what they did, and how you kept quality up. If someone underperformed, tell us what you did about it.

pages.title: How do you describe your ethnicity?
pages.description: We ask this to help us understand whether our applicant pool is inclusive. Choose the option that best describes you.

fields.label: Ethnicity
fields.help: Choose the option that best describes you.

pages.title: How do you keep working through load shedding?
pages.description: Describe your exact setup: inverter, UPS, generator, backup location, whatever keeps you online when the grid is not.

pages.title: Thank you, {first_name}.
pages.description: Your application is in and a real person will read it. If your answers match what we need, you will hear from us with next steps. Keep an eye on your inbox.
